title: Your First Weekend at University of North Carolina Wilmington, Shared as Cards
description: A flexible, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence that begins on campus and branches into documented Wilmington activities.

cards.title: Get Oriented with the Campus Map
cards.subtitle: Start at UNCW’s main campus
cards.notes: Open the interactive map before heading out, then use it to locate buildings, parking, and the next stops in your own walking route.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for turning a new campus into a navigable place.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW provides an interactive main-campus map with building, parking, and location details.
cards.access_notes: Use the interactive map for current destination and parking details.

cards.title: Find Randall Library
cards.subtitle: UNCW campus
cards.notes: Take a pass through Randall Library and save its floor maps for later; they identify spaces in both Randall Hall and Discovery Hall.
cards.short_summary: A campus landmark with official floor maps to keep handy after the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW Library publishes floor maps for Randall Hall and Discovery Hall.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours and access information before visiting.

cards.title: See What’s Showing at Boseman Gallery
cards.subtitle: Fisher University Union
cards.notes: Stop by the gallery in the Fisher University Union, then check the exhibition page to see which student, local, or regional work is on view.
cards.short_summary: A year-round campus gallery with changing exhibitions and a permanent collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ann Flack Boseman Gallery displays varied media year-round and schedules five exhibitions annually featuring UNCW, local, and regional artists.
cards.access_notes: Review the current exhibition listing before making a dedicated trip.

cards.title: Check the Lumina Theater Calendar
cards.subtitle: First floor, Fisher Student Center
cards.notes: Look for a film, lecture, panel, or concert that fits your weekend. Confirm the specific program’s ticketing and entry details before you go.
cards.short_summary: A 333-seat campus theater set up for films and other public-facing programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Lumina Theater is on the first floor of the Fisher Student Center and supports film programming, lectures, panels, and concerts.
cards.access_notes: Programming and admission vary by event; consult the event listing before attending.

cards.title: Watch for a UNCWeekends BINGO Night
cards.subtitle: Recurring UNCW weekend programming
cards.notes: Check WaveLink for an upcoming themed BINGO Night and bring a friend; UNCWeekends lists it among its recurring campus activities.
cards.short_summary: A documented alcohol-free weekend activity hosted through UNCW Campus Activities.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCWeekends lists themed BINGO Night among the activities it hosts and provides alcohol-free options every weekend during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Available during the academic year; use WaveLink to confirm the date, location, and entry details.

cards.title: Make Time for a Campus Craft
cards.subtitle: Recurring UNCWeekends activity
cards.notes: Look for a Catching Up With the Crafts session on WaveLink and join the posted activity; UNCWeekends supplies the materials for this program.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on, alcohol-free option that can anchor a low-key campus afternoon.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCWeekends identifies Catching Up With the Crafts as an activity where the program brings the supplies.
cards.access_notes: Dates and locations vary; confirm the posted event details on WaveLink.

cards.title: Check Out the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: UNCW campus recreation
cards.notes: Ask about student access and available activities at the recreation center, then choose an option that fits your group and the facility schedule.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation destination connected to UNCW’s health and wellness programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW Campus Recreation identifies the Pat Leonard Student Recreation Center as one of its facilities and programs supporting student wellbeing.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and activity availability depend on membership status and the current schedule.

cards.title: See Whether the Seahawks Are Home
cards.subtitle: UNCW campus athletics venue
cards.notes: Check the current athletics schedule for a home game, then plan around the posted start time and ticket information for Trask Coliseum.
cards.short_summary: UNCW’s basketball home floor and a recurring setting for campus game days.
cards.evidence_claim: Trask Coliseum is the home floor for UNCW’s men’s and women’s basketball teams.
cards.source_title: Trask Coliseum - Facilities | UNC Wilmington Athletics
cards.access_notes: Game schedules, ticket requirements, and door times vary by event; verify them with UNCW Athletics.

cards.title: Add an Art-Museum Detour
cards.subtitle: 3201 South 17th Street, Wilmington
cards.notes: Plan a daytime museum visit around the rotating exhibitions and outdoor spaces. Bring a current local university or college student ID for the stated student admission policy.
cards.short_summary: A Wilmington museum with rotating exhibitions, outdoor grounds, and a documented local-student admission option.
cards.evidence_claim: Cameron Art Museum is open Tuesday through Sunday, with Thursday hours until 9 p.m., and states that local university and community-college students receive free admission.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Cameron Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Current hours are Tuesday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; Thursdays are open until 9 p.m. Verify closures and bring qualifying student ID.

cards.title: Finish with a Beach Walk
cards.subtitle: 25 East Salisbury Street, Wrightsville Beach
cards.notes: Use the town-listed access for an oceanfront walk and its restroom, shower, gazebo, and ADA-accessible route; follow posted beach conditions and rules.
cards.short_summary: A named public beach access with amenities documented by the Town of Wrightsville Beach.
cards.evidence_claim: Wrightsville Beach Access Number 16 at 25 East Salisbury Street has parking, an ADA-accessible route, a gazebo, restrooms, and a shower, and is listed as open year-round from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m.
cards.source_title: Beach Accesses, Public Restrooms, & Lifeguard Stand Locations | Wrightsville Beach, NC
cards.access_notes: Town-listed access hours are 7 a.m.–9 p.m., year-round. Parking availability and fees may apply; check the town’s current parking information.
